subject: LedgerCorp — consolidation of invoice lanes and net terms request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@ledgercorp.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: LedgerCorp Billing <billing@ledgercorp.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating invoices and net terms for upcoming renewal

Hi Chloe,

We’re getting ready for our annual renewal and expansion (adding +200k tokens / month capacity through Q4). Our finance team has asked to consolidate all invoices to a single billing lane and issue them on net45 terms going forward. Currently we receive separate invoices per BU and it’s creating reconciliation overhead.

Can Redwood route all charges to billing@ledgercorp.com and issue a single monthly invoice? Also attaching the PO we’ll use for this renewal (LedgerCorp_PO_45091.pdf). Please confirm whether Redwood can accept net45 on the committed capacity portion and what the effective date would be.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, LedgerCorp

Attachment: LedgerCorp_PO_45091.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ledgercorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating invoices and net terms for upcoming renewal

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the PO. Congratulations on the capacity expansion — excited to support the increased usage.

Short answers up front:
- We can consolidate invoices to billing@ledgercorp.com and switch to a single monthly invoice that covers committed capacity and overage usage.
- Finance needs to approve net45 for the committed portion; I’ve looped in Rishi (Finance) to confirm and note the PO.
- Tentative effective date: first invoice under new terms would be the start of the next billing period after we receive signed amendment (target: 2028-10-01).

To move forward I’ll need:
1) Confirmation that billing@ledgercorp.com is the authoritative billing contact (and who should receive past-due notices).
2) The signed PO (you included it, thank you) and a signed amendment/acceptance — I’ll send a DocuSign for the term amendment & net45 request.
3) A W-9 or applicable tax form for LedgerCorp (if your finance team prefers, we can accept W-9 by email).

Rishi / Vivek — note PO attached. Can Finance approve net45 for the committed portion for LedgerCorp (deal LDG-2028-09-001)? If yes, please confirm any credit controls or invoice hold policy to communicate back.

If helpful we can set a 20-minute call Friday to align on sign-off.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
Cell: (415) 555-0143
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@ledgercorp.com>, LedgerCorp Billing <billing@ledgercorp.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating invoices and net terms for upcoming renewal

Chloe — I reviewed the PO and LedgerCorp’s history. Finance can approve net45 on the committed capacity under these conditions:
- We need a signed amendment (DocuSign) that explicitly changes billing terms to net45 for the committed portion only. Overage will remain due on receipt (net0) unless otherwise negotiated.
- Billing contact required: billing@ledgercorp.com (we’ll mark this as primary for both invoices and dunning).
- We will run a soft credit check and place a credit cap tied to the committed monthly spend. If LedgerCorp requests net45 beyond the cap we’ll need a corporate guarantee or prepayment agreement.

Action items for our side: Vivek, please prepare the amendment (SOW/terms) reflecting: consolidated monthly invoice, net45 on committed spend, overage invoiced on receipt, effective 2028-10-01 pending signature. Chloe — I’ll approve net45 once amendment is uploaded to DocuSign and LedgerCorp signs.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ledgercorp.com>, LedgerCorp Billing <billing@ledgercorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Sep 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating invoices and net terms for upcoming renewal

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick turnaround on the PO and for confirming billing@ledgercorp.com as the billing lane.

Next steps completed on our side:
- I’ve uploaded the amendment and SOW to DocuSign: "Redwood Amended Terms — LedgerCorp" (link: https://www.docusign.com/Signing?doc=LDG-2028-09-001).
- Attachments for your records: Redwood-updated-SOW.pdf (summary of committed capacity and pricing) and Redwood_W9.pdf (company tax form).
- Finance (Rishi) has pre-approved contingent net45 pending signed amendment; once signed we’ll change the billing contact to billing@ledgercorp.com and consolidate invoices starting 2028-10-01.

Please sign the DocuSign envelope at your earliest convenience. Once signed I’ll confirm the first consolidated invoice date and send a summary of the new invoice format (single line items for committed capacity + overage breakouts).

If you prefer a short call to walk through the invoice sample I can schedule one.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-updated-SOW.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
